title: Replace the retired gRPC Swagger integration
goal: Keep a gRPC service's transcoded JSON interface discoverable after retiring its documentation adapter by generating and checking a protobuf-derived contract at build time.

packageAssets: Grpc.AspNetCore/Grpc.Net.Client/Grpc.Tools2.64.0; actual Windows x64 protoc26.1 and grpc_csharp_plugin. Current JsonTranscoding11RC2 net11.0, historical Swagger0.10.11/JsonTranscoding10.0.13/Swashbuckle6.6.2 net10.0. Locked transitives and actual selected tool/import/managed assets are recorded.

Pinned protoc-gen-openapiv2v2.31.0 Windows x64 executable10039808bytes SHA256214ecb46f982f3c8f1ac07ded35ea01ef87ca4a53e018ea9832f9e67b999ceac; separate release-checksum manifest SHA256c69d16ba8e39d420c42f4684a4521b1453bb13f70f25d99490318e80a498a242. No Go installation or PATH integration.
providers: Actual ASP.NET JSON transcoding runtime, not a Go gateway server. gRPC-Gateway protoc-gen-openapiv2 is used only as a supported protobuf document build tool.
platforms: Qualified execution: Windows x64 only. No NativeAOT, trimming or other OS/native-provider execution claim.
renderingModes: JSON contract retrieval only; no Swagger UI/browser or third-party generated-client execution claim.
prerequisites: Qualify actual document generation BEFORE replacing the old service adapter. Restore pinned Grpc.Tools and JsonTranscoding imports, acquire/check the exact generator, run the supplied script and inspect nonempty operations/schemas/comments; then compile and exercise the real service.
constraints: There is no matching Swagger11RC2 package or direct AddGrpcSwagger replacement. Generic AddOpenApi registration alone does not establish transcoding operations. This route serves a static build artifact generated from the original annotated proto; regenerate after proto changes.

The output is Swagger2.0/OpenAPIv2, not OpenAPI3.x. Its operations/messages/comments are generated by the supported third-party tool. No automatic runtime reflection, ASP.NET API explorer integration or drop-in adapter compatibility is claimed.

The actual old Swagger0.10.11 package has net10.0 assets and a JsonTranscoding10.0.11 minimum; the measured consumer explicitly selects10.0.13 plus Swashbuckle6.6.2. This historical route really runs on net10.0. Retention on net11.0 has not been qualified and is not offered. The old adapter was experimental and is now deprecated; no obsolete suppression is added.

Only unary GET with one string path field and string/int32 response fields is qualified. Default lowerCamelCase JSON names and matching protobuf imports are used. int64, bytes, enums, optional/oneof, streaming, body/query bindings, custom JSON options and arbitrary Google HTTP patterns need their own contract/runtime checks.

A document that has no paths, omits a response field, drops protobuf comments or disagrees with actual gRPC/JSON wire types is failure. This sample resolves the actual response reference and checks its schema against the actual returned JSON.

Use separate ephemeral HTTP1 and cleartext HTTP2 loopback ports only in the fixture; no certificate trust or global transport switch is changed. Production HTTPS/listeners, authentication and document exposure policy remain application responsibilities. Keep package/tool licenses and provenance; do not hand-author a replacement generator or expected document.
stabilityLimitations: Exact reproduction uses SDK10.0.402 / framework10.0.13 / C#14 versus SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 / framework11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 / C#15. These are tested pins, not minimum supported versions. RC2 is not actual-GA proof. The exact eight approved .NET10 foundations, stable identities, PIN-959/PIN-963/PIN-964 and unrelated Human gates remain unchanged.

evidence.scope: Both locked actual services compile/run. The old adapter produces a nonempty OpenAPI3 document with RPC/message/field comments; the new pinned generator produces Swagger2.0 with corresponding GET operation, path parameter and response schema/comments. Real gRPC and transcoded JSON return station willow, heightCm142 and observedAt2026-10-01T06:30:00Z. The checks resolve each actual document response reference and compare all returned wire-field types, int32 format and comments; unknown station is gRPC NotFound/JSON404, wrong method405 and wrong path404. Native protoc/gRPC C# plugin and independent generator hashes are retained. This proves the bounded primitive mapping, not all Google annotation patterns or generated-client interoperability.
